properties.name: Yokosuka Naval Base (橫須賀海軍基地)
properties.stationed: HQ US 7th Fleet, Carrier Strike Group 5 (USS George Washington CVN-73), Destroyer Squadron 15
properties.significance: Largest and most strategically vital forward US naval installation in the Western Pacific, projecting air and carrier strike capabilities across East Asia.

properties.name: Kadena Air Base (嘉手納空軍基地)
properties.runway: 12,100 ft (3,688 m) & 12,100 ft Dual Heavy Runways
properties.stationed: 18th Wing, F-15EX / F-22A rotational fighters, KC-135 Stratotanker, E-3 Sentry AWACS, RC-135 Rivet Joint
properties.significance: Known as the 'Keystone of the Pacific', Kadena is the premier forward hub for air dominance, electronic reconnaissance, and aerial refueling across the Taiwan Strait and East China Sea.

properties.name: Andersen Air Force Base (關島安德森空軍基地)
properties.runway: 11,185 ft (3,409 m) & 10,558 ft (3,218 m) Parallel Runways
properties.stationed: 36th Wing, Continuous Bomber Task Force (B-52H, B-1B, B-2A), RQ-4 Global Hawk UAVs
properties.significance: Cornerstone of US Indo-Pacific Strategy second-island-chain power projection, capable of sustaining massive strategic bomber operations across the Western Pacific.

properties.name: Zuoying Naval Base (海軍左營軍港司令部)
properties.runway: Dedicated Naval Deepwater Pier System & Heliport
properties.stationed: ROC Navy Fleet Command, 124th Flotilla (Kang Ding-class Frigates), 192nd Underwater Fleet
properties.significance: Primary operational homeport of the Republic of China Navy, anchoring southern Taiwan Strait maritime defense, anti-submarine warfare, and sealane protection.

properties.name: Hsinchu Air Base (空軍新竹基地)
properties.stationed: 2nd Tactical Fighter Wing (Mirage 2000-5Ei/Di Interceptors), Sky Bow III SAM Battery
properties.significance: Closest ROC airbase to mainland China (~140 km across strait), maintaining continuous 6-minute rapid scramble air superiority alert over northern Taiwan.

properties.name: Leshan Early Warning Radar (樂山長程早期預警雷達站)
properties.stationed: Combat Air Control Center, AN/FPS-115 PAVE PAWS Phased Array Radar (Raytheon)
properties.significance: Provides real-time 3D ballistic missile detection, tracking, and cueing up to 5,000 km range, tracking PLARF ballistic missile launches into the deep interior of Asia.

properties.name: Hualien Jiashan Underground Base (花蓮佳山地下戰略空軍基地)
properties.runway: 9,800 ft (2,987 m) Highway Interlink & Deep Mountain Tunnels
properties.stationed: 5th Tactical Fighter Wing (F-16V Viper), Underground Hardened Aircraft Shelters (200+ jets capacity)
properties.significance: Taiwan's most heavily fortified military facility, excavated deep into the Central Mountain Range to preserve fighter wings against massive initial missile barrages.

properties.name: Chiayi Air Base (空軍嘉義基地)
properties.stationed: 4th Tactical Fighter Wing (F-16V Block 20 with APG-83 AESA Radar & AIM-120C-7 AMRAAM)
properties.significance: First fully upgraded F-16V wing in the world, holding central Taiwan maritime approach defense and conducting routine ADIZ interception sorties.

properties.name: Suao Naval Base (海軍蘇澳北方澳軍港)
properties.stationed: 168th Flotilla (Kee Lung / Kidd-class Guided Missile Destroyers with SM-2MR)
properties.significance: Commands Taiwan's eastern Pacific approaches and sea lines of communication linking to Yonaguni Island and southern Japan.

properties.name: Camp Humphreys (韓國韓福瑞斯營)
properties.runway: 7,124 ft (2,171 m) Desiderio Army Airfield (A-2) Runway
properties.stationed: HQ United Nations Command, ROK-US Combined Forces Command, Eighth US Army, 2nd Infantry Division
properties.significance: Largest overseas US military base in the world (3,450 acres), serving as the core nerve center for joint defensive operations on the Korean Peninsula.

properties.name: Osan Air Base (烏山空軍基地)
properties.stationed: 51st Fighter Wing (F-16C/D, A-10C Thunderbolt II), 5th Reconnaissance Squadron (U-2S Dragon Lady)
properties.significance: Most forward-deployed air base in Korea (~77 km from DMZ), maintaining high-altitude U-2 strategic reconnaissance over North Korea.

properties.name: Misawa Air Base (三澤空軍基地)
properties.stationed: 35th Fighter Wing (F-16CM Wild Weasel / SEAD), JASDF 3rd Air Wing (F-35A Lightning II)
properties.significance: Dual US-JASDF base in northern Honshu specializing in Suppression of Enemy Air Defenses (SEAD) and monitoring the Sea of Okhotsk / Russian Far East.

properties.name: Sasebo Naval Base (佐世保海軍基地)
properties.stationed: Amphibious Squadron 11 (USS America LHA-6 Amphibious Ready Group, USS Green Bay LPD-20)
properties.significance: Primary forward staging port for US Marine Expeditionary Units and amphibious rapid response across the East China Sea and Korea.

properties.name: Ramstein Air Base (拉姆施泰因空軍基地)
properties.runway: 10,499 ft (3,200 m) & 9,186 ft (2,800 m) Parallel Runways
properties.stationed: HQ Allied Air Command (AIRCOM), HQ US Air Forces in Europe – Air Forces Africa (USAFE-AFAFRICA), 86th Airlift Wing
properties.significance: Nerve center for NATO air defense across Europe and central global airlift gateway connecting the continental US with Europe, Africa, and the Middle East.

properties.name: RAF Lakenheath (英國雷肯希思空軍基地)
properties.stationed: 48th Fighter Wing ('Statue of Liberty Wing'), 493rd & 495th Fighter Squadrons (F-35A Lightning II)
properties.significance: First permanent forward operating base for US Air Force F-35A 5th-generation stealth fighters in the European theater.

properties.name: Rota Naval Station (西班牙羅塔海軍基地)
properties.stationed: Destroyer Squadron 60 (USS Arleigh Burke, USS Roosevelt Aegis BMD Destroyers)
properties.significance: Key gateway to the Mediterranean, hosting forward-deployed Aegis Ballistic Missile Defense destroyers safeguarding southern Europe.

properties.name: Al Udeid Air Base (卡達烏代德空軍基地)
properties.stationed: HQ US Air Forces Central (AFCENT), Combined Air Operations Center (CAOC), 379th Air Expeditionary Wing
properties.significance: Largest US military installation in the Middle East, commanding air and space operations from Egypt to Afghanistan.

properties.name: NSA Bahrain (巴林海軍支援處 / 第五艦隊司令部)
properties.runway: Mina Salman Deepwater Naval Pier Facility
properties.stationed: HQ US Naval Forces Central Command (NAVCENT), HQ US 5th Fleet, Combined Maritime Forces (CMF)
properties.significance: Commands all US naval operations in the Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz, Arabian Sea, and Red Sea, ensuring international commercial energy transit.

properties.name: Camp Thunder Cove (狄耶哥加西亞戰略基地)
properties.runway: 12,000 ft (3,658 m) All-Weather Heavy Bomber Runway
properties.stationed: B-2A Stealth Bomber forward shelters, Maritime Prepositioning Ships (MPSRON 2), SSGN Submarine tender berths
properties.significance: Isolated British atoll in the central Indian Ocean providing unassailable staging for long-range stealth strikes into the Middle East, South Asia, and Africa.

properties.name: Naval Station Norfolk (諾福克海軍基地)
properties.runway: 8,000 ft (2,438 m) Chambers Field Runway, 14 Piers (75 ships capacity)
properties.stationed: HQ US Fleet Forces Command, HQ NATO Joint Force Command Norfolk, Carrier Strike Group 2, 8, 10, 12
properties.significance: The epicenter of US Atlantic naval strength, home to 5 Nimitz/Ford-class nuclear aircraft carriers and 75 surface combatants.

properties.name: Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam (珍珠港-希卡姆聯合基地)
properties.stationed: HQ US Pacific Fleet, HQ Pacific Air Forces (PACAF), Submarine Force Pacific, 15th Wing (C-17 Globemaster, F-22A Raptor)
properties.significance: Headquarters of the United States Pacific Fleet, controlling all US naval assets from the US West Coast to the Indian Ocean.

properties.name: Whiteman Air Force Base (懷特曼空軍基地)
properties.stationed: 509th Bomb Wing, 131st Bomb Wing (Sole operational home of B-2 Spirit Stealth Bombers, B-21 Raider testbed)
properties.significance: Home of America's B-2 Spirit stealth bomber fleet, capable of delivering conventional and B61-12 thermonuclear ordnance anywhere on the globe non-stop.

properties.name: Pine Gap Joint Defense Facility (松樹谷防衛設施)
properties.runway: Hardened Radome Array (38 radomes) & Remote Helipads
properties.stationed: CIA / NSA / Australian Defence Signals Directorate, Satellite Ground Terminals (ORION, MENTOR geostationary SIGINT)
properties.significance: One of the most critical intelligence collection sites in the Western world, intercepting ballistic missile telemetry, tactical comms, and radar emissions across Asia.

properties.name: Pituffik Space Base / Thule (格陵蘭圖勒太空基地)
properties.stationed: 12th Space Warning Squadron (AN/FPS-132 Upgraded Early Warning Radar - UEWR)
properties.significance: Northernmost US military installation (750 miles north of the Arctic Circle), providing early warning of ICBM launches coming over the North Pole.

properties.name: Changi Naval Base (新加坡樟宜海軍基地)
properties.stationed: Republic of Singapore Navy, US Navy Task Force 73, littoral combat ship (LCS) rotational deployments
properties.significance: Guards the eastern entrance to the Strait of Malacca; specifically built with berths to support US nuclear supercarriers operating in Southeast Asia.

properties.name: Subic Bay Naval Base (菲律賓蘇比克灣軍事基地)
properties.runway: Deepwater natural harbor & Subic Bay International Airport (9,000 ft runway)
properties.stationed: Philippine Navy Fleet Command forward patrol, US Indo-Pacific Command rotational surveillance detachments
properties.significance: Dominates the eastern approaches to the South China Sea, located just 140 nautical miles east of Scarborough Shoal.

properties.name: Yalong Bay / Sanya SSBN Naval Base (三亞亞龍灣核潛艇基地)
properties.runway: Deepwater Submarine Tunnels & Dual Aircraft Carrier Piers
properties.stationed: PLAN South Sea Fleet, Submarine Flotilla 32 (Type 094 Jin-class SSBN, Type 093 Shang-class SSN), Carrier Shandong (17)
properties.significance: China's premier underground submarine fortress carved into coastal mountains, allowing nuclear ballistic missile submarines to submerge directly into deep South China Sea trenches.

properties.name: Sevastopol Naval Base (塞瓦斯托波爾海軍基地)
properties.runway: Natural deepwater sheltered bays & drydock facilities
properties.stationed: Russian Navy Black Sea Fleet (Admiral Grigorovich-class Frigates, Kilo-class Project 636.3 Submarines)
properties.significance: Historical strategic bastion in Crimea controlling maritime dominance over the Black Sea, heavily contested by maritime drone strikes.
